caption: The video captures a transparent sphere bearing a red curved marking on its upper-left side, suspended above a tan granular surface against a solid black backdrop. The camera remains fixed as the marked sphere drifts slowly upward, widening the gap between its lower edge and the textured plane below. Near the upper-left edge, a second plain transparent sphere slides into view, followed shortly by a third positioned just above it. These two unmarked spheres descend together in a steady vertical line, maintaining a constant separation from one another while closing the distance to the rising central sphere. The red marking holds a consistent orientation throughout, showing no rotation. No contact, merging, or exit occurs among the spheres within the visible portion of the clip.
